difficulty_reason: The proof identifies the map of \'etale local rings \mathcal{O}_{Y, f(\overline{x})} \to \mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}}, notes it is flat by the cited flat-at-a-point lemma, and uses going down for flat ring maps (cited) to transfer the unique minimal prime from \mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}} to \mathcal{O}_{Y, f(\overline{x})}, which is exactly geometric unibranchedness at the image point. The transport through \'etale local rings is the substance.
